subject.title: Claude CLI sessions reset on every turn in group channels due to groupIntro drift in extraSystemPromptHash

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91157 be allowed to close this broader issue, or should maintainers keep this issue canonical until the announce/live-fingerprint variants are fixed or split to canonical trackers?
rationale: Current main appears to have a partial groupIntro and binding-level stabilization, but the issue discussion now includes active stable-release evidence for adjacent announce and live-fingerprint variants that the linked groupIntro PR may not cover.

options.title: Keep canonical until split
options.body: Review the linked groupIntro PR but prevent it from closing this issue until announce/live-fingerprint variants are fixed or moved to clearly linked canonical issues.

options.title: Split remaining variants
options.body: Create or designate narrower trackers for announce delivery and Claude live fingerprint churn, then allow this issue to close once the groupIntro path is proven fixed.

options.title: Broaden linked PR
options.body: Require the linked PR to cover the remaining announce and live-fingerprint paths before merge, increasing scope but keeping one closure path.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical until split
recommendation.body: Review the linked groupIntro PR but prevent it from closing this issue until announce/live-fingerprint variants are fixed or moved to clearly linked canonical issues.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the static prompt hashing PR and authored adjacent follow-up work in the same session prompt hashing surface.
